page.title: al-Marṣad Sky Atlas
page.description: The whole graph of the Sīra as one sky you can turn and be guided through: the Prophet ﷺ as the light at the centre, the events on a spiral in the order Ibn Hishām tells them, and every person, place and story as a mark you can open down to its source. Every claim is proposed and not yet reviewed.
page.nojs: The Sky Atlas needs JavaScript to draw the sky. The same records are on the reader pages of al-Marṣad, which work without it.
search.label: Find a person, event, place, story or group
search.placeholder: Find a name, in English or Arabic (press /)
search.none: No name matches. Try fewer letters, or another spelling.
depth.label: Depth
band.text: Every claim here was compiled, mostly by an AI pass over Ibn Hishām's Sīra, and none has been reviewed by a scholar yet. Each record shows its source and its status.
stage.label: The sky of the Sīra
stage.help: Drag to turn the sky, pinch or scroll to zoom, two fingers or Shift-drag to move. Tap a mark to open its record, or a line to see the evidence behind it. Arrow keys turn, + and − zoom, 0 fits the view, Enter opens the mark at the centre, / finds a name, Esc steps back.
views.label: View
zoom.label: Zoom
welcome.title: A sky of the Sīra, to be guided through
welcome.text: The light at the centre is the Prophet ﷺ. The gold marks on the spiral are events, in the order Ibn Hishām's Sīra tells them. Around them are the people the text names, settled by their recorded links. Start the guided tour, or turn the sky and tap any mark.
welcome.counts: {people} people · {events} events · {places} places · {claims} claims, all proposed
record.label: Record
guide.label: Guide
guide.tours_note: Each tour flies the camera from stop to stop. At every stop you see who was there, where, what the record says and its source, and where you can go next. The order of a tour comes from the record: the order of the text, recorded dates, or a reading order.
guide.from_here_note: Open any record and press “Guide me from here”: a life, in the order the text names its events; a place, with what happened there; an event, with the people recorded at it.
guide.trace_note: Open a record and press “Trace from here”, then open another record and press “Trace to here”. The path shows each step's record and source.
tour.draft: This journey's selection rule is a draft: it has not been approved by the maintainer and the scholars' board yet.
tour.ecliptic.title: The Sīra as Ibn Hishām tells it
tour.ecliptic.lead: Every event the text names, in the order it tells them (where most of each event's records sit in the text): the spiral of the sky, from its first turn to its last. This is the order of a book, which is not always the order of time.
tour.dated.title: Every dated event
tour.dated.lead: The events whose dates are recorded, from the earliest recorded date to the latest. The date at each stop is the recorded one, as written.
tour.j_hijrah-step-by-step.title: The Hijrah, step by step
tour.j_hijrah-step-by-step.lead: The events the record ties to the Hijrah, in the order the record supports.
tour.j_people-of-badr.title: The people of Badr
tour.j_people-of-badr.lead: The people the record places at Badr.
tour.j_first-believers.title: The first believers
tour.j_first-believers.lead: The stories of the Makkan period from the 50 Stories document, in reading order, with the people each story names.
tour.ten.title: The ten promised Paradise
tour.ten.lead: al-ʿashara al-mubashsharūn, in the order of the report that names them, beginning with the four rightly guided caliphs. The list is proposed and awaits the scholars' review.
tour.stories.title: The 50 Stories
tour.stories.lead: The 50 Stories of the Prophet ﷺ and his Companions, in the document's reading order. The document is AI-written and unreviewed; it is shown as a guide to the people, not as a source.
tour.opposition.title: Opposition, and the turning
tour.opposition.lead: The people a claim records as fighting against the Prophet ﷺ or opposing him, in the order the text names them. Where a claim says a person later accepted Islam, the record says so.
tour.opposition.note: Only what a claim records is shown. A person with no recorded side is not drawn as an opponent, and nobody is judged here.
tour.dyn.life.lead: {name}, then the events the record places them at, in the order the text names them, then their recorded family.
tour.dyn.place.lead: {name}, the events recorded there in the order of the text, and the people recorded there.
tour.dyn.around.lead: {name}, and the people recorded with it, in the Atlas's order of people.

light.note: The Prophet ﷺ is drawn as the light at the centre of every view, never as one mark among many. The image of the sky and its stars is this project's metaphor; it is not a quotation of any hadith.

list.ten: One of the ten promised Paradise

mark.turned: Recorded as opposing, later accepted Islam
mark.opponent_note: The sky draws this person as a dark mark because of the claims below. Nothing else about them is judged.
mark.turned_note: The sky draws this person as a dark mark at the time of the claims below, and as a star when “The turning” is on, because a claim records that they later accepted Islam.
facet.events_note: In the order the text tells them.

claim.gloss: AI gloss, machine-written and not reviewed:
ladder.nograde: No grading is recorded for this report.
trace.note: The graph connects these two through separate records. No text states this connection as a whole.
trace.rules: The path takes the fewest steps, counting a family step as two. It never passes through the Prophet ﷺ, who is linked to almost everyone.
trace.lineage: Allow paths through names known only from lineages
trace.none: No path joins these two in the record.
trace.start_set: Trace starts at {name}. Open another record and press “Trace to here”.
trace.stories: Connection stories, written or approved by a scholar, will appear here. None has been approved yet, so none is shown.
show.lines_note: One line for each pair joined by a recorded claim, coloured by the kind of relationship.
show.background_note: {n} people the graph knows only from lines of descent. They hang outside the events.
show.turning_note: {n} people are drawn dark because a claim records them fighting against or opposing the Prophet ﷺ. Of these, {k} carry a claim that they later accepted Islam: switch this on to draw them as stars.
show.orbit_note: Turns the sky slowly until you touch it. Off by default.
show.orbit_reduced: Off, because your device asks for reduced motion.
index.title: Index
index.note: Every mark in the sky, as a list.
sort.links_note: The Atlas's order puts the Prophet ﷺ first, then the four, then the ten, then the rest by recorded links. Recorded links count how often the sources mention a person: coverage, never rank. People recorded as opposing the Prophet ﷺ come last.
log.title: Your logbook
log.note: What you have observed, kept in this browser only. The milestones count your own exploring; they never rank a person.

key.marks: Marks: shape and colour show the kind only
key.light_text: The Prophet ﷺ, at the centre of every view. Never a mark among others.
key.person_text: Stars. Their brightness shows their recorded generation and nothing else.
key.event_text: Gold four-pointed stars. In the Sky they lie on the spiral, in the order of the text.
key.story_text: Rose rings: the 50 Stories, on the outer ring.
key.dark_text: People a claim records as fighting against or opposing the Prophet ﷺ. Never drawn as stars or light, unless “The turning” is on and a claim records that they later accepted Islam.
key.gen_note: Most people in the full Sīra layer have no recorded generation yet. They are drawn plain.
key.data_text: {nodes} marks and {claims} claims, plus {records} other records. {text} marks are named in Ibn Hishām's text. {dated} of {events} events carry a recorded date, and {located} of {places} places carry recorded coordinates.
key.status_text: Every claim is proposed. {reviewed} have been reviewed by a scholar. Read nothing here as settled history.
key.duplicates: The full Sīra layer was read in parts, so one person can appear under several entries (for example several people named al-Zubayr). Merging them is the next step, by an editor with scholars for the hard cases.
rule.provenance: No pixel without provenance: the sky draws only what the records publish.
rule.depiction: No depiction: light, geometry, position and names only.
rule.ai: AI never asserts: it may choose a route or a camera, never a fact.
rule.rank: Computed is not significant: no count is shown as rank.
rule.outlive: The data must outlive the app: open schema, open export.
key.licence_text: Text and data: CC BY-SA 4.0. Code: AGPL-3.0. Identifiers: CC0. Coastlines: Natural Earth (public domain). al-Marṣad contributors.
caption.sky: The light at the centre is the Prophet ﷺ. Events lie on the dotted spiral in the order Ibn Hishām's text tells them; the 50 Stories ring the sky. Everyone else sits by their recorded links.
caption.book: Ibn Hishām's text from its first page to its last, left to right. People and places sit where the text first names them; events where most of their records sit. Marks the text never names stand on the left.
caption.time: Recorded dates, in years CE. People sit at the dated events they took part in. Marks with no recorded date are not shown here.
caption.map: Places at their recorded coordinates, with the events and people recorded there gathered round them. The light hangs above the land and marks no place.
caption.map_count: {n} of {total} places have recorded coordinates so far.
caption.lineage: Ancestors above, children below, spouses and siblings beside, as the kinship claims record them.
lineage.need: Open a person's record first, then choose Lineage.
book.axis: Ibn Hishām, al-Sīra al-Nabawiyya: volume and page
time.ah1: 622 CE: year 1 of the Hijra calendar
time.lane.people: People, at the dated events they took part in
error.unpack: This browser cannot unpack the Atlas's data. Please open it in a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
error.webgl: This browser cannot draw the sky (WebGL is off or missing). Please try another browser or device.
blend.label: Blend views
caption.stories: The 50 Stories on a dial in reading order, grouped by part. People and places sit inside, near the stories that name them. Everything else waits on the shelf below.
caption.globe: A turning globe: places at their recorded coordinates on Natural Earth coastlines, with their events and people round them. Gold arcs join the places of the dated events, one after another: the order of the record, not a route.
caption.chains: Transmission: the recorded chains narrator by narrator on the left; on the right, everyone in recorded narration in layers by their distance from the Prophet ﷺ.
caption.chains_count: {n} recorded chains; {k} people in recorded narration.

gpu.off: Faster drawing off: the plain canvas draws the sky.

index.dupes_note: {g} written names are shared by {e} entries.
key.absent_text: A broken coral ring with a stroke: recorded as absent from the event in focus. Absence is shown only where a record states it.
key.chain_light: “Light by chain distance” lights {n} people by their distance from the Prophet ﷺ in recorded narration: the recorded chains and every “narrated from” claim.
key.cluster_text: A ring with a number: nearby stars merged until you zoom in (when “Group nearby stars” is on). Every group is the same size.
key.data_more: {tabaqa} people have a recorded generation; {chains} recorded chains hold {links} links. {dupes} written names are shared by {dupe_entries} entries.
key.hollow_text: No recorded date. Drawn hollow while a period or history is shown, never hidden and never placed by guesswork.
key.motion: Motion only when you turn, zoom, flick or change the view, or press Play. Nothing drifts on its own unless “Slow turn” is on.
key.never: Nothing is invented to fill a gap: no date, place, chain or name is guessed, and nothing is interpolated.
key.reader_none: This copy of the Atlas is not published with the reader pages, so records do not link to them.
key.test_text: Grey-blue pinpoints, only when you add a test load. Synthetic points, never records: never in search, the panel or the lists.
key.trail: A gold dashed line with numbers is a guided tour's route, stop by stop, in the tour's order.
